title: Render an object to a gtable for a layout — as_layout_gtable
code: # an object that renders as a 40 x 30 mm panel with a 10 mm label on the left as_layout_gtable.labelled_box <- function(x, ...) {   gt <- gtable::gtable(     widths = grid::unit(c(10, 40), "mm"),     heights = grid::unit(30, "mm")   )   gt <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(gt, grid::textGrob(x$label, rot = 90), t = 1, l = 1,                                 name = "label")   gtable::gtable_add_grob(gt, grid::rectGrob(gp = grid::gpar(fill = "grey80")),                           t = 1, l = 2, name = "panel") } registerS3method("as_layout_gtable", "labelled_box", as_layout_gtable.labelled_box)  box <- structure(list(label = "box"), class = "labelled_box") new_row(dummy(), box)

title: Layout options — layout_size
text: layout_size() sets figure size mm, e.g. journal column width (Nature: 89 mm single column, 183 mm double column). Free panels absorb extra space; none, becomes slack placed according containers' alignment. layout_spacing() sets gaps neighbouring plots mm, measured outer boxes (axis labels, legends tags included). replaces plots' plot.margin, gaps even plots use different themes. Without , gaps come plot margins. outer adds margin around whole figure. Note axis labels can stick past panel (e.g. last tick label); ggplot2 normally relies plot margin space. small gaps, labels may overlap neighbouring plots, figure's edge can cut ; use small outer margin (1-2 mm) . layout_tags() adds panel tags. Tags aligned top row, even plots row different heights, plots stacked left edge column share one tag line, even axis labels differ width. let several plots share one tag, use tag_group(). layout_title() adds title figure.

text: Starting adding. first argument layout, new row (column, grid) added . Otherwise, new layout started, new_row(p1, p2) simply row p1 p2. start new row existing layout first element, wrap list: new_row(list(inner), p3). Several plots one call form one row (column): new_column(p5, p6) single column p6 p5, whereas new_column(p5) |> new_column(p6) gives two columns side side. Layouts can also passed elements, e.g. new_column(new_grid(...)) puts grid right. Panel alignment. Plots aligned panel edges, outer boxes. Within row, panel bottoms line default (x axes); within column, panel left edges line (y axes). Rows vs. grids. row laid : new_row(p1, p2) |> new_row(p3, p4), rows line left edge outermost panels, p2 p4 need line . new_grid(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2), every grid column wide widest panel, p2 sits exactly p4. grid, NULL leaves empty cell. Spare space. plots fixed size, row (column, grid) often space plots need. horizontal_align vertical_align decide space goes inside row: place plots spread space . title: tidylayouts 0.0.0.9000
text: New layout engine built ggplot2 grid; longer depends ggalign. Plots aligned panel edges, also across nested rows columns. Removed row(), column() grid(); use new_row(), new_column() new_grid(). horizontal_align vertical_align (defaults "left" "bottom") place plots row, column grid; nested rows, columns grids fill space use alignment. grid shares row column tracks. New new_layout() builds layout design string, e.g. "ABEF\nCDEF\nGGGG". Letters place plots; default design line becomes row (arrange_by = "row"), alternatively column grid. Tags numbered reading order, tag_group() works inputs. Plots keep sizes; auto_width, auto_height, auto_margins_x auto_margins_y change listed plots. New new_row(), new_column() new_grid() build layout step step: call adds row , column right, grid everything built far. replace add_right() add_below(). new_row(..., wrap = <mm>) breaks long row lines, like text word processor; new_column(..., wrap = <mm>) breaks tall column several columns; new_grid(..., wrap = <mm>) picks many grid columns fit. New auto_width() auto_height() let layout decide plot’s panel size; auto_margins() keeps panel size centers plot spare space next . set_size() sets fixed panel size mm tidyplots plain ggplots. New tag_group() lets several plots share one panel tag. New save_layout() saves figure exact physical size. layout_tags() aligns tags top row left edge column; layout_size() sets figure size mm. spacer() without size now absorbs leftover space. Plot backgrounds drawn plots, axis labels sticking past plot longer covered neighbouring plot’s background. layout_spacing(inner, outer) now sets gaps plots mm (one value, c(horizontal, vertical)), replacing plots’ margins, plus optional outer margin around figure. Removed layout_alignment(); use horizontal_align vertical_align.
